meta.name: frontend-slides
meta.description: Create stunning, animation-rich HTML presentations from scratch or by converting PowerPoint files. Use when the user wants to build a presentation, convert a PPT/PPTX to web, or create slides for a talk/pitch. Helps non-designers discover their aesthetic through visual exploration rather than abstract choices.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将PPT或想法转为动画HTML演示文稿
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速制作带动画的HTML幻灯片或转换PPT为网页版
copy.tagline_en: Convert PPT or ideas into animated HTML presentations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly create animated HTML slides or convert PPT to web

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能直接生成可在浏览器中运行的 HTML 幻灯片，支持从零创建或转换 PPT 文件，并自动适配屏幕、添加动画和导航。
howto.when: 当你需要制作演讲、提案或教学用的幻灯片，或者想将 PPT 文件转为网页版时触发。

say.text: 帮我做一个关于AI趋势的HTML幻灯片，10页左右。
say.note: Claude 会先询问风格偏好，然后生成预览供你选择。

say.text: 把这个PPT文件转成HTML幻灯片。
say.note: Claude 会提取内容并应用视觉风格。

say.text: 帮我改进这个HTML幻灯片的布局和动画。
say.note: Claude 会优化现有幻灯片的设计和交互。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate HTML presentations that run in the browser, create from scratch or convert PPT files, with viewport fitting, animations, and navigation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to create a presentation for a talk, pitch, or workshop, or convert a PPT/PPTX file to web slides.

say_en.text: Create an HTML slideshow about AI trends, about 10 slides.
say_en.note: Claude will ask about style preference and generate previews.

say_en.text: Convert this PPT file to an HTML presentation.
say_en.note: Claude will extract content and apply visual style.

say_en.text: Improve the layout and animations of this HTML slideshow.
say_en.note: Claude will enhance design and interactions.
